trap.label: verbo de estado
trap.wrong: By then I will have been knowing her for years.
trap.right: By then I will have known her for years.
trap.why: Em português “estarei conhecendo” soa estranho, mas “conheço há anos” leva o aluno a tentar o contínuo. Verbos de estado (know, have, be) não usam -ing.

mcq.q: “By dawn we ___ arguing for fourteen hours.”

opts: a point that ends the deal

fix.wrong: By dawn we will have argue for fourteen hours.
fix.right: By dawn we will have been arguing for fourteen hours.

fix.wrong: By then she will have been having a house for years.
fix.right: By then she will have had a house for years.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “By dawn we argue for fourteen hours.”
rewrite.answer: By dawn we will have been arguing for fourteen hours.

rewrite.prompt: Corrija o estado: “By then I will have been knowing her for years.” (known)
rewrite.answer: By then I will have known her for years.
